hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let string be the text "interrupt_action_at_hello" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
If string is set, then call game:ai.AiUtil.registerInterruptAbilityByAiArgTag with (string, the enemy).
Call arg.

flow.text: Let string be the text "interrupt_action_at_hello" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.

hooks.logic:
If the enemy is judged dead, then
  Let string be the text "interrupt_action_at_dead" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
  If string is set, then call game:ai.AiUtil.registerInterruptAbilityByAiArgTag with (string, the enemy).
  Choose state 15 next and stop.
If the HP fraction of the enemy is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_over_soul" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then choose state 14 next and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: The enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

hooks.logic:
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for the enemy under the phases list.
If paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is not the current form of the enemy, then
  The enemy changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
If the enemy is judged dead, then
  Let string be the text "interrupt_action_at_dead" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
  If string is set, then call game:ai.AiUtil.registerInterruptAbilityByAiArgTag with (string, the enemy).
  Choose state 15 next and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
